question: Can T-1 stock structure repair the long-only regime split that intraday chasing could not?

preregistration.single_factor_blend: 50% clean momentum within-day rank + 50% structural factor rank
preregistration.combo_selection: 2021-2023 only; >=3pp CAGR improvement and no worse MDD under both costs; max two factors
preregistration.oos_isolation: 2024-2026 is descriptive validation only and never used for selection

factor_definitions.LOW_EXTENSION_MA20: prefer less price extension above/below MA20 within an already-strong core universe
factor_definitions.PULLBACK5: prefer lower recent 5-day return within the strong 20-day core; anti-chase hypothesis
factor_definitions.TREND_EFF20: prefer larger 20-day net log displacement / total absolute log-return path
factor_definitions.AMOUNT_SWEET: prefer amount_accel inside existing pre-registered 1.2x-2.0x moderate acceleration interval
factor_definitions.TURNOVER_SWEET: prefer turnover inside existing pre-registered 3%-15% active interval
